ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity (white) wedge-shaped regions are situated on the lateral lobes. These regions are bifurcated by a low-intensity (black) central vertical column extending from the peduncle to the median notch. The light-colored patches are bounded by low-intensity margins at the leading and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge displays low-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities. Subtle serration is detectable on the distal third of the right lobe, while the left lobe trailing edge remains relatively smooth with minor pixel-level deviations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges of both lobes follow a broad convex curve from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several localized, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters are visible within the high-intensity white patches, most notably a cluster of three small spots near the upper boundary of the right lobe patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, non-symmetrical indentation or 'notch' is visible on the outer distal margin of the right fluke lobe.
